title: Set several fields in one ModifyAll call
summary: Consecutive ModifyAll calls on the same filtered record are merged into a single call that sets several fields, cutting SQL round trips. Where RunTrigger was passed, OnModify now runs once per row with all fields already set instead of once per field.
key_points: Back-to-back ModifyAll calls on the same record are merged into one call
Field and value expressions are unchanged and keep their order
With RunTrigger, OnModify runs once per row instead of once per field; three such cases are outside test code
One run is left unmerged because its calls disagreed on RunTrigger
Touches about 300 files across W1 apps, localization layers and demo data
quote: Every place that called ModifyAll repeatedly on the same record with nothing in between now makes a single call.
